classification.difficultyReason: Rearrange the given area constraint and substitute into the rectangle perimeter formula.

content.prompt:
The area of a rectangle is to be 50 m².

Show that its perimeter is given by the equation $P=2x+\frac{100}{x}$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2, rectangle below the stem at the left
spec.description: Unshaded landscape rectangle with x below its horizontal base and y beside its right vertical side. Ordinary source-grey strokes are rendered black in house style.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle side lengths x and y metres; area xy=50 square metres.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent question diagram; no answers supplied in the diagram.

answer.worked:
Area:
$$\begin{align*}50&=xy\\\frac{50}{x}&=y\end{align*}$$
Perimeter:
$$\begin{align*}P&=2x+2y\\P&=2x+2\left(\frac{50}{x}\right)\\P&=2x+\frac{100}{x}\end{align*}$$
The perimeter is measured in metres.
